_note: Every default and range used by the app. Units SI. Defaults must equal owc_toy.Params() (regression anchors in README).

A.label: wave amplitude A
A.tip: Regular-wave amplitude (half the wave height). Power scales with A^2.

h.label: water depth h
h.tip: Sets k through the dispersion relation w^2 = g k tanh(k h).

r_in.label: inner chamber radius r_in
r_in.tip: Water-plane area S = pi r_in^2. The piston idea needs k r_in below about 1.

L.label: effective column length L
L.tip: Includes added mass. Sets the natural frequency sqrt(g / L); it does not depend on r_in in this toy.

zeta.label: damping ratio zeta
zeta.tip: Toy radiation damping of the piston, constant with frequency (a toy choice, not physics).

H_air.label: air-chamber height H_air
H_air.tip: V0 = S H_air. Larger V0 means larger aPTO (air spring); above a threshold the PTO resonance disappears.

rho.label: water density rho
rho.tip: Seawater about 1025 kg/m^3, fresh water 1000 kg/m^3.

rho0.label: air density rho0
rho0.tip: Enters aPTO = w V0 / (v^2 rho0). 1.2 kg/m^3 is the author's choice, not a paper value.

v.label: speed of sound in air v
v.tip: Enters aPTO = w V0 / (v^2 rho0). 340 m/s as in Zheng et al. (2019).

damping.tip: Constant: B = 2 zeta sqrt(K m), the toy (regression anchors). Frequency-dependent: B(w) = k rho g S^2 (2 J1(k r_in)/(k r_in))^2 / (4 cg), an estimate that gives the physical w^3 long-wave scaling of c; zeta is then not used.

T.label: wave period T (regular waves)
T.tip: Period of the regular wave, T = 2 pi / w. Not Te, Tp, Tm01 or Tm02: those belong to irregular seas. Default = PTO resonance for the default inputs.

c_pto.tip: Turbine conductance. 'optimal' retunes it at every frequency (paper Eq. 39 form): an upper bound, a real turbine cannot do this.

d_over_h.label: chamber draft d / h
d_over_h.tip: Submergence of the chamber wall over depth.

beta_deg.label: incident direction beta
beta_deg.tip: Incident wave direction; 90 deg is normal to the wall.

L.label: vertical truncation L
L.tip: Number of evanescent vertical modes kept.

rho0.label: air density rho0
rho0.tip: Air density; rho/rho0 = 1000 as in the paper.

v.label: speed of sound in air v
